title: Why Are Black People Leaving Church

top_liked.author: @henrim9348
top_liked.text: Don't forget that lots of people are "cultural Christians". They see the church as a tradition, not literally. They are afraid to declare themselves non religious because of the social consequences.

top_liked.author: @williambeckett6336
top_liked.text: "If you're black and christian you have a real short memory"-Chris Rock.

top_liked.author: @NeedSomeNuance
top_liked.text: I feel like the black church, while serving as a safe social hub for black folk for a long time, has also served as a means of keeping black ppl docile and forgiving towards oppressors

top_liked.author: @JDrocks4ever
top_liked.text:
This was very well explained. I’m a black man who was raised in the church. I took the faith very seriously in 2018, became a minister and founded a Christian organization in 2019, then left the faith in December of 2023.

I’m a truth seeker and was constantly growing and…

top_liked.author: @Redx3257
top_liked.text: Shout out to my fellow black atheists... Its nice to see some of yall on here, and nice to know i aint alone! Darante' keep doing what you are doing. I appreciate you.

top_liked.author: @Introvert_4_Life
top_liked.text: I stopped believing when i noticed that my prayers were falling back in my face. Also, My prayers and fasting about sick family members rendered no good results. My sister and dad died from cancer. No prayers were answered. That was my cracking point.

top_liked.author: @marcsman07
top_liked.text: "Not everybody who's becoming an atheist is becoming a critical thinker" Such a true point

top_liked.author: @robind.phillips2129
top_liked.text: When I left religion, I felt that none of these religions belonged to me. I was not interested in finding another church. Anyway, thanks for sharing.

top_liked.author: @DHigable
top_liked.text: My life didn’t truly start to blossom until I began to look to myself for answers instead of some invisible man in the sky. Black men like myself left the church because we know game when we hear it. To be honest, church “never” sat right with me. I always felt uncomfortable…

top_liked.author: @henrim9348
top_liked.text: Thanks again for doing the Lord's work,  I'm a black atheist who grew up mostly in Africa. i left the church when my pastors couldn't explain to me how Africa animals got on the ark. But my family is still very deep in it. Everyone is scared of going to hell. The concept of hell…
